name: Dire Bat
description: A wide-winged pet endlessly loyal to their vampire owner.

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: While flying, the Bat gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

abilities.name: Screech
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to send a high-pitch screech out toward all targets in front of the Bat within Far range. Those targets must mark 1d4 Stress.

abilities.name: Guardian
abilities.description: When an allied Vampire marks HP, you can mark a Stress to fly into Melee range of the attacker and make an attack with advantage against them. On a success, deal 2d6+2 physical damage.
